t: You're looking at the Dyson building, home of the Dyson School of Design Engineering, part of the Faculty of Engineering at Imperial College London. It stands at the corner of Exhibition Road and Imperial College Road. The school has just over sixty academic and teaching staff and around eight hundred students. It is named for Sir James Dyson, the English inventor and industrial designer who founded the Dyson company. He is best known for the bagless vacuum cleaner, which works by cyclonic separation.
